 Judgment
One of the main grounds raised by the petitioner is that, the petitioner was not heard, before the said decision is taken.
3. A detailed counter affidavit has been submitted by the petitioner.
Several documents which ultimately led to the respondents to arrive at a decision to terminate the contract, WP(C) NO. 38006 OF 2025 :3: 2026:KER:12933 have been furnished.
It is discernible there from that, Ext.P5 order was passed without hearing the petitioner.

4. In such circumstances, it is ordered that Ext.P5 shall be treated as a notice, and it shall be open to the petitioner to submit objection to Ext.P5, if any, and it shall be submitted within a period of one week from the date of receipt of copy of this judgment.
Upon receipt of the same, a final decision shall be taken by the respondent, after giving the petitioner an opportunity of being heard, within one month from the date of submission of such objection.
Until such a decision is taken, the petitioner shall be entitled to continue the operation of the canteen.

However, it is clarified that, in case the objection as referred to above is not submitted within the period specified above, the respondents shall be entitled to proceed further, to implement Ext.P5 The Writ Petition is disposed of as above.
